## Overview

- Add multi-shape marquee selection and editing to the Architecture Designer.
- Improve the Architecture Designer guidance and documentation for diagram editing workflows.
- Keep the Canvas Extension, Agent Skills, CLI, and Desktop on the unified 3.6.0 release.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible for existing Markdown decks. No migration is required.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v3.6.0`. |
| Architecture Designer | Existing architecture documents remain compatible; multi-selection is available for editing multiple shapes together. |
